<!-- PHI-DIRECT -->
```powershell
Write-Output '=== INSTRUMENT CLEANUP 401 - THE DIAGNOSTIC BLOCKS OUT OF THE CHARACTER SOURCE AND THE GAME CODE UNTOUCHED (The fall stands closed on the record: job 398 printed PROOF LINES LANDED from the run of job 395 - floorBlock 1, floorActor StaticMeshActor_3, capZ 98.2 unmoving at ticks 5, 30, 60 and 120, moveMode walking - the proof the diagnostic instruments from jobs 365, 371 and 372 were built to win. Their work is done, and the scaffolding comes out now so the game carries none of it. THIS JOB, merged base at D VEIL-OMNI: one, read VEILCharacter.cpp and VEILCharacter.h whole and print every line carrying PHI SPAWN, PHI TICK, PHI TUMBLEKILL or PHI CCDLOCK, with the bounds and full text of the block enclosing each marked line - the census, printed before any edit. Two, where the census finds no instrument blocks, print INSTRUMENTS ALREADY ABSENT and stop without editing. Three, back both files up, then remove exactly the instrument blocks - the print statements and the flag writes standing inside those blocks and nowhere else - leaving the movement, capsule and mesh code untouched, and print the removed line count; a block whose bounds or brace balance cannot be proven instrument-only is held whole and named, and nothing is written. Four, read both files back and print the verification: the count of lines carrying those four markers stands at zero. Five, compile the editor target on the Build.bat road and print BUILD SUCCEEDED or the compiler error lines whole.) ==='
$waited = 0
while ((Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -and $waited -lt 10) { Start-Sleep -Seconds 10; $waited++ }
if (Get-Process UnrealEditor -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { Write-Output 'EDITOR STATE AT PROCEED: an editor still stands after the 100 second in-job wait - proceeding under that state, with the named hold EDITOR STILL STANDING on the record' }
else { Write-Output 'EDITOR STATE AT PROCEED: no editor standing - proceeding on the clear road' }
$base = 'D:\VEIL-OMNI'
$uproj = "$base\VEIL.uproject"
$cppItem = Get-ChildItem "$base\Source" -Recurse -Filter 'VEILCharacter.cpp' -File | Select-Object -First 1
$hdrItem = Get-ChildItem "$base\Source" -Recurse -Filter 'VEILCharacter.h' -File | Select-Object -First 1
if (-not $cppItem) { Write-Output 'VEILCHARACTER CPP NOT FOUND'; Write-Output 'JOB 401 STOPPED'; return }
$cpp = $cppItem.FullName
$hdr = ''
if ($hdrItem) { $hdr = $hdrItem.FullName } else { Write-Output 'VEILCHARACTER H NOT FOUND - census runs on the cpp alone' }
Write-Output ("CPP: " + $cpp + " bytes=" + $cppItem.Length)
if ($hdr) { Write-Output ("HDR: " + $hdr + " bytes=" + $hdrItem.Length) }
$py = (Get-Command python -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source
if (-not $py) { $py = (Get-Command py -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).Source }
if (-not $py) { Write-Output 'PYTHON NOT FOUND'; Write-Output 'JOB 401 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output "PYTHON: $py"
Write-Output '--- SECTION 1: CENSUS BEFORE ANY EDIT ---'
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force "$base\Saved" | Out-Null
$pyS = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetString([System.Convert]::FromBase64String(''))
$cppFwd = $cpp -replace '\\', '/'
$hdrArg = "'NONE'"
if ($hdr) { $hdrArg = "'" + ($hdr -replace '\\', '/') + "'" }
$pyS = $pyS.Replace('ZZCPPZZ', "'" + $cppFwd + "'").Replace('ZZHZZ', $hdrArg).Replace('ZZOUTZZ', "'D:/VEIL-OMNI/Saved/phi_clean401_out.txt'")
Set-Content "$base\Saved\phi_clean401.py" -Value $pyS -Encoding UTF8
Remove-Item "$base\Saved\phi_clean401_out.txt" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
& $py "$base\Saved\phi_clean401.py" 2>&1 | Write-Output
if (Test-Path "$base\Saved\phi_clean401_out.txt") { Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_clean401_out.txt" | Write-Output } else { Write-Output 'NO CLEAN401 OUTPUT FILE'; Write-Output 'JOB 401 STOPPED'; return }
$outTxt = Get-Content "$base\Saved\phi_clean401_out.txt" -Raw
if ($outTxt -match 'PHI CLEAN401 STATUS: ABSENT') { Write-Output 'INSTRUMENTS ALREADY ABSENT'; Write-Output 'JOB 401 DONE'; return }
if ($outTxt -match 'PHI CLEAN401 STATUS: HELD') { Write-Output 'INSTRUMENT REMOVAL HELD - nothing written; the held block stands printed whole in the census'; Write-Output 'JOB 401 STOPPED'; return }
if ($outTxt -notmatch 'PHI CLEAN401 STATUS: REMOVED') { Write-Output 'CLEAN401 STATUS UNREAD - nothing written'; Write-Output 'JOB 401 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 2: APPLY THE REMOVAL, BACKUP FIRST ---'
Copy-Item $cpp "$cpp.phi-backup-401" -Force
Write-Output 'CPP BACKED UP (.phi-backup-401)'
if ($hdr) { Copy-Item $hdr "$hdr.phi-backup-401" -Force; Write-Output 'HDR BACKED UP (.phi-backup-401)' }
if (Test-Path "$cpp.clean401") { Copy-Item "$cpp.clean401" $cpp -Force; Write-Output 'CPP CLEANED FILE APPLIED' }
if ($hdr -and (Test-Path "$hdr.clean401")) { Copy-Item "$hdr.clean401" $hdr -Force; Write-Output 'HDR CLEANED FILE APPLIED' }
Write-Output '--- SECTION 3: READ-BACK VERIFICATION ---'
$allText = [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($cpp)
if ($hdr) { $allText += [System.IO.File]::ReadAllText($hdr) }
$vBad = 0
foreach ($mk in @('PHI SPAWN', 'PHI TICK', 'PHI TUMBLEKILL', 'PHI CCDLOCK')) {
  $cnt = ([regex]::Matches($allText, [regex]::Escape($mk))).Count
  $vBad += $cnt
  Write-Output ("VERIFY MARKER " + $mk + " count: " + $cnt)
}
if ($vBad -ne 0) { Write-Output 'VERIFY FAILED - markers remain after the removal'; Write-Output 'JOB 401 STOPPED'; return }
Write-Output 'VERIFY: ZERO INSTRUMENT MARKERS REMAIN'
Write-Output '--- SECTION 4: COMPILE THE EDITOR TARGET ---'
$target401 = -join ([char[]](86,69,73,76,69,100,105,116,111,114))
$buildbat = 'C:\Program Files\Epic Games\UE_5.8\Engine\Build\BatchFiles\Build.bat'
$blog = "$base\Saved\compile401.log"
$p = Start-Process $buildbat -ArgumentList @($target401,'Win64','Development',"-Project=$uproj",'-WaitMutex','-NoHotReload') -Wait -PassThru -WindowStyle Hidden -RedirectStandardOutput $blog -RedirectStandardError "$blog.errlog"
Write-Output ("BUILD exit: " + $p.ExitCode)
Select-String -Path $blog -Pattern 'error C[0-9]+|error :|Error|Traceback|Exception|Result:|Total time' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -Last 15 | ForEach-Object { $_.Line.Trim() } | Write-Output
if ($p.ExitCode -ne 0) { Write-Output 'BUILD FAILED'; Write-Output 'JOB 401 STOPPED AFTER BUILD'; return }
Write-Output 'BUILD SUCCEEDED'
Write-Output 'JOB 401 DONE'
```
